header.source: KNOWLEDGE · etymology joined to atoms, anon door

rows.definition: To watch without touching — attention that leaves its subject unchanged; the witness's verb.
No longer used, though it may still work. Obsolescence is a fact about the world moving on, not about the thing.
The one currently dwelling in a space — presence with an address; the cadastre's word for who holds a parcel.
Of the open sea — vast, deep, and continuous; a blue with distance in it.
The reading of printed marks back into text a machine can handle. It recovers language from an image of language.
Of Odin — who gave an eye at Mimir's well for a drink of memory and wisdom. A named power in this house's pantheon, and the reason the well has that name.
Belonging to, or made from. The word that ties a thing to its source or its whole.
To put a thing forward for another to take or leave. An offer that cannot be refused is not one.
A distance from a reference point. An offset is meaningless without saying from what.
A dark olive-toned Prism theme — the name enters as itself, a dress code wears.
The runtime this house hosts local models on. A named tool rather than a concept.
Resting upon, or in an active state. Names contact or operation.
The bringing of a newcomer to the point where they can act. Onboarding is where a system says what it expects of people.
A single thing, and the beginning of counting. Also wholeness — the same word for a unit and for being undivided.
This and nothing else. The word that closes a set to one.
Concerning what kinds of things exist and how they relate. Where taxonomy ranks, ontology connects.
How much a thing blocks what lies behind it. Full opacity hides; none reveals.
Not closed against entry or inspection. Openness is a standing condition, not a single act.
A single act a system performs. Named as a unit so it can be counted, ordered and undone.
One who works a system, and a symbol that acts on values. Both apply something to something else.
An opening that will not stay open. Named for the moment rather than the thing.
Best against a stated measure. Nothing is optimal in general — only for something.
Making a thing better against a chosen measure. Optimisation always sacrifices what was not measured.
Improved against a chosen measure. Optimisation always sacrifices what was not measured.
That which improves a thing against a chosen measure. It always sacrifices whatever was not measured.
One of several things that may be chosen. An option is only real if declining it is also permitted.
May be taken or left, with neither being a failure. Optionality is only real if declining costs nothing.
A work, especially one large enough to stand alone. From the Latin for labour — an opus is named for the effort in it.
A source consulted for what cannot be worked out. An oracle answers; it does not explain.
Spoken rather than written. Oral knowledge lives only while it is still being said.
A sphere considered as a whole thing. Having no face and no edge, it is the same from every side.
A path that circles something without ever reaching it. Held by attraction and by motion at once.
To bring many players into one music — coordination that serves the whole without silencing any part.
The deciding of what acts when, across many parts. Orchestration produces nothing itself and everything depends on it.
That which decides the order many parts act in. It plays nothing itself and everything depends on its timing.
A body's working part — one function given flesh; and the instrument of many voices under one wind.
Living wholes whose parts serve one another. In this Grammar, names built of three or more words.
An ordering that makes things findable, and a body of people arranged for a purpose. Both are structure imposed so work can happen.
To put into an order that makes things findable. Organising creates no new content and changes what can be reached.
That which puts things into an order that makes them findable. It creates no content and changes what can be reached.
Knowing which way one faces, and what lies around. Orientation must be established before direction means anything.
Where a thing began. A myth explaining how something started — the story of first causes and founding moments.
Left without the parent that gave it context. An orphaned thing still exists and no longer means what it did.
Belonging to us. The word that claims a thing for a group the speaker is inside.
Away from an inside. Names departure or exposure.
How a thing turned out. An outcome is judged against what was hoped, which is why the same result reads differently to different people.
The shape of a thing given by its edge alone. Also a plan showing structure without contents.
What a process gives back. The far side of input, and the only part anyone else sees.
Beyond the bound. Names what is not within, and therefore not governed by what is.
Taken as a whole rather than in parts. An overall figure hides every distribution inside it.
What exceeds the space it was given. Overflow must be handled deliberately, or it is simply lost.
Where two things occupy the same ground. Overlap is where a boundary was drawn in the wrong place, or in two places.
A layer laid over another without replacing it. What is beneath stays, and is seen through or covered by choice.
To set aside a standing rule for this case. An override should leave a trace, since it is an exception someone chose.
A view of the whole from far enough back to see its shape. An overview loses every detail on purpose.
To arrive in more quantity than can be met. Overwhelm is not weakness; it is a limit being exceeded.
To write over what was there, losing it. Overwriting is the one edit that cannot be undone by reading.
To have as one's own and answer for it — possession with responsibility inside it; sovereignty's quiet verb.
The standing to decide what happens to a thing. Ownership is about authority, not possession.
The mark for a paragraph. A fragment as it appears in this library, not an English word.
Of the named ocean, and peaceable. Named by a sailor who found it calm on the day he crossed.
Things bundled together and offered as one. A package decides what travels together.
A bounded unit of what is being sent, complete enough to travel alone. Large messages are made of many.
Deliberate empty space held inside a boundary. Room kept so a thing does not press against its own edge.
Belonging to the older local practices rather than the established religion. Its root means of the countryside — the belief that stayed where people lived.
One surface of a larger work. A unit of reading, bounded by how much a reader can hold at once.
Taken in pages — walked chunk by honest chunk past every row cap; how large truths are read without false emptiness.
To divide a long body into pages that can be asked for one at a time. It makes the unmanageable reachable.
The division of a long body into pages that can be asked for one at a time. It makes the unmanageable reachable.
What a body reports when it is being harmed or has been. Pain is information that cannot be argued with and is constantly disbelieved.
Two things taken together as one unit. A pair is more than two — the pairing is itself a fact.
A companion, informally. As it appears here, part of a named payment service.
The set of colours chosen to work with. A palette is a limit accepted so the whole will hold together.

Pandulipi (Sanskrit पाण्डुलिपि: a manuscript — literally a pale-ochre writing, the sheet before it is a book). The typescript as an editor expects to receive it, and nothing beyond that: twelve-point monospace with Courier named first and the family names left as data a consumer may override, double-spaced, one-inch margins on a US Letter page and A4 by one option that switches the @page size VALUE and not one other character of the sheet; a title page carrying the author's contact block top-left verbatim and the word count top-right rounded to the nearest hundred, with the exact count riding beside it so the convention loses nothing; the title a third of the way down and the by-line beneath it; every chapter beginning a third of the way down a fresh page; a scene break set as one centred hash, whether it was written as a hash, three stars or three spaced stars; paragraphs indented half an inch with no blank line between them; italics kept as italics, underline one option away and one CSS rule wide. THE TEXT IS NEVER ALTERED, and that is the whole carefulness of it: every literal run of the source is recorded with its byte offsets and is a byte-exact slice, every character no run covers is one of a declared markup alphabet so a dropped word would stand in a gap as its own letters, and markdown the dialect does not set rides as its own characters, never mended — no smart quotes, no folded ellipsis, no dash substitution, no collapsed whitespace, no corrected typo. THE PAGE COUNT IS THE PRINT ENGINE'S: the running head is one @page margin box with a CSS counter in it, upper-cased by CSS so no case change touches the text, and the result declares `pages` and never sets it. No glyph typesetting, no hyphenation, no kerning, and no widow or orphan rule claimed or written. No clock, no disk, no network, no host global, zero imports: a manuscript in, one paged HTML out.
A bounded surface set into a larger one. Also a small group convened to judge.
A view wide enough to include what a single glance would miss. Breadth bought at the cost of detail.
The full set of a tradition's named powers, held together as one company. A pantheon is a structure of relation, not a list.

Panti (Sanskrit paṅkti पङ्क्ति: a row, a line of things set side by side; and the metre whose verses stand in fives). A table's own logic as data, holding no data: how a column's sort direction cycles, what a typed filter mode means, which rows are chosen, and what a row's stable identity is. THE CYCLE CLOSES — null to ascending to descending to null — so three clicks on a header return the order the rows arrived in, which a two-state toggle makes unreachable. AN ABSENT VALUE IS NOT A SMALL VALUE: null and undefined sort LAST in both directions, the one asymmetry in the whole surface and the right one. Sorting is a COPY and never a mutation, and every selection act returns a new Set, so nothing a caller still holds is changed underneath it. Three filter modes and no fourth — contains, exact, startsWith, all case-folded — with a whitespace-only needle refused as no filter at all and a null cell matching nothing. A row's id is the row's OWN key where it has one, so it travels with the row through a re-order and a selected row stays selected; where the data offers no identity the fallback is positional and the water says so rather than offering an illusion. No DOM, no framework, no clock, no network, zero imports, and nothing throws.
The apparent shift of near things against far ones as the viewer moves. Depth revealed by motion rather than by sight alone.
Running alongside without meeting. Parallel things share a time, not a path.
A named value passed in to shape how something runs. Short form of parameter.
A named value passed in to shape how something runs. Parameters are where a general thing becomes particular.
A measured piece of land or load — the cadastre's unit: bounded, named, placeable.
That which another descends from or is contained within. The relation is named from above.
To read structure out of a sequence. Parsing decides where the parts begin and end, and that decision can be wrong.
That which reads structure out of a sequence. It decides where the parts begin and end, and that decision can be wrong.
Some but not all. Partial is honest where incomplete sounds like failure.
One who takes part, and holds a share by taking part. Named for their presence in the thing rather than their use of it.
Takes part in, and holds a share by taking part. Names presence in a thing rather than use of it.
A very small piece treated as indivisible. Also a small mark of movement in a rendered scene.
One who shares the work and the outcome equally. A partner is not a helper; the difference is who carries the cost.
A bond in which two remain two and act as one. Partnership is a form rather than a feeling; it holds on the days nobody feels it.
Those gathered — for celebration, or as a side in an exchange; the line where both meanings meet is consent.
A naming convention where each word starts capitalised and none are separated. A named convention rather than a concept.
Having met the standard, or having gone by. The same word for succeeding and for being over.
A secret held so that knowing it proves who you are. A password protects only while it stays unshared.
The small mend applied in place — change shaped exactly to the hole it heals.
A way worn by being walked. Not built - a path is the record that others went first.
A route through a structure, understood as one of several. A pathway is a way that exists whether or not it is walked.
A named platform where supporters fund a maker directly. A named tool rather than a concept.
Support given so that work can continue. The supporter takes no ownership of what the support makes possible.
A form worth repeating, held up as the thing to copy. The same word as patron - a pattern is what stands over the work as its example.
A deliberate stop that is not an ending. Space held open so what comes next can be chosen rather than fallen into.
To give value in exchange. Payment closes an obligation.
The carried content, as against the carrying. The part that matters once the envelope is discarded.
Value given in exchange for something received. Payment closes an obligation.
A format that fixes a document's appearance wherever it is opened. A named format rather than a concept.
The highest point reached — summit of a curve, a signal, a day.
Awaiting a resolution that has not come. Pending is an honest state, not a failure.
For each of. The word that turns a total into a rate.
A part expressed as hundredths of a whole. It states proportion while hiding size.
A part expressed as hundredths of a whole. It states proportion while hiding size.
To carry out, and to do before an audience. Both mean acting in a way that can be judged.
How well a thing does what it does, and the act of doing it before others. Both senses are measured by a watcher.
A bounded stretch of time, and the mark that ends a sentence. Both are ways of saying this much and no further.
Leave granted to do a thing. Permission implies someone had the standing to withhold it.
To continue past what would have ended it. Also to write a thing down so it survives the session.
The property of outlasting the moment that made it. Persistence is what turns state into memory.
A face shown to others, which may or may not be the whole self. Originally the mask through which an actor's voice came.
Belonging to one being in particular. Of what is theirs by nature rather than by grant.
How a thing appears from one position. Every perspective is true from where it stands and none is the whole.
One distinct stage of a longer process, with its own character. Phases follow; they do not overlap.
An image fixed from light. Its root is light itself — a photograph is writing with it.
Words grouped so they carry meaning together that none carries alone. The unit between word and sentence.
Of the material body and the world it is in. Of what has weight and can be touched.
The study of how matter and energy actually behave. Physics is the layer beneath which no further why is available.
To take one out of several. Picking is choosing with the emphasis on the taking.
A control for choosing one from a shown set. It makes the range of the possible visible.
A part that is whole enough to handle — one of many, complete in the hand.
A small rounded form holding one thing. Also a rounded label carrying a single value.
An upright that carries weight from above. Remove a pillar and what it held comes down.
A chain of stages where each hands its output to the next. A pipeline's speed is its slowest stage.
How high or low a sound stands — frequency worn as music; the sensory channel of tone's height.
The smallest addressable point of a shown image. Everything visible on a screen is made of these and none of them is visible alone.
A where with a name — and the verb of setting a thing into its own.
Something standing in the position of what has not arrived. It holds the space and makes no claim to be the thing.
Where a thing is put. Placement carries meaning that the thing itself does not.
An intended sequence set down before acting. A plan's worth is in having thought, not in being followed.
A wanderer that orbits a star — world enough to hold seasons; the sky's larger bodies, each with its own weather.
A living thing rooted where it grows, making its own food from light. Also to set something into the ground for later.
A flat surface made to carry — the ground a thing is served on. A plate receives; what it carries is the gift.
A raised flat ground others stand on. What holds a thing up, and what shapes whatever gets built there.
Activity done for its own sake, inside chosen rules. Play is not the reward for work; it can be the destination.
The showing again of what was recorded. Playback returns the record, never the moment.
One who takes part in a game, and the thing that renders a recording. Both make something happen that was waiting.
A bounded place made for trying things freely. Consequence is suspended on purpose so that learning can happen.
An ordered set of pieces chosen to be heard together. The choosing and the ordering are both authorship.
Marked-off pieces of ground, and the shapes stories take. Both are areas someone drew a line around.
An added part that extends a system without altering it. A plugin belongs to the host and is not of it.
The joining word of addition — this and also that; arithmetic's welcome.
A position with no extent. Also the meaning something is driving at — both are exact locations.
A Prism theme named for the New Mexico pueblo — warm earth tones carrying the place's name with respect.
A standing decision applied to all cases of a kind. Policy exists so the same question need not be answered twice.
A gathered quantity held in common and drawn from as needed. What is in it belongs to the pool, not to any one drawer.
To take the most recent thing off a stack. Also a sharp brief sound.
To fill an empty structure with its contents. Populating turns a shape into a thing.
A surface that appears over what was there, uninvited. It takes attention by arriving.
The sheltered threshold before a door — where a house meets its visitors; in this house, every kin's own front step.
A place ships come in, and a numbered doorway a system listens on. Also to carry a thing across to a new ground.
A doorway into somewhere else. A portal is defined by what it opens onto, not by its own shape.
A likeness of a particular person. Also taller than wide — the orientation named for the pictures it suits.
Where a thing stands relative to others. Position is always relational; nothing has one alone.
Able to happen. Possibility is a claim about what is not ruled out, not about what is likely.
Something published for others to meet. Also an upright that bears weight, and to send onward.
What a thing could become but has not. Potential is real and is not yet evidence of anything.
The Windows shell of objects and verbs — half the street wakes here; its quirks are documented so they bite once.
Concerned with what actually works rather than what should. Of judgment tested against use.
Repeated doing that builds capacity. Also the settled way a group works — both mean something done often enough to become known.
Before. A part placed at the front to move a thing earlier in time or order.
What is said before the substance, to set what follows in place. A preamble is orientation, not content.
The first stage that raises a weak signal enough to be worked with. Everything after it inherits what it did.
Made in advance rather than on demand. Prebuilding trades flexibility for speed at the moment of use.
How finely a value is stated. Distinct from accuracy — a precise number can be precisely wrong.
Short form of preference. A leaning toward one option, held without needing justification.
A leaning toward one option over another, held without needing justification. A preference is stated, not argued.
Leans toward one option over another. In interfaces, the stated setting a body needs rather than wants.
A part placed before a word to change its meaning. It carries no meaning alone and alters everything it joins.
To fetch a thing before it is asked for. Preloading spends effort on a guess about what will be wanted.
Above the standard offering, at a higher price. Premium is a claim about tier, not about quality.
That which prepares material before the main work begins. It runs first so the real process can assume things.
Being here, and being felt to be here. Presence is more than location — it is attention actually given.
The keeping of a thing against loss and decay. Preservation is active work, not storage.
To keep from loss or change — protection across time; lose-nothing made a verb.
That which keeps a thing against loss and decay. Preservation is active work, not storage.
A saved arrangement of settings, ready to be chosen whole. Someone's earlier good decision, offered again.
To push with steady force. Also the making public of what was written — both apply pressure until something takes.
To reformat a thing so it reads better. Prettifying changes presentation and must not change content.
Short form of previous. The one coming before this in an order.
A showing of what a thing will be before it is committed. A preview reduces surprise at the cost of finality.
Coming before this one. Previousness is a fact about order, and carries no claim about being superseded.
